summary: gate a plan that adds a StageProposal field
pull_request_body: The plan adds a field to `StageProposal` and holds no task that updates the prompt reply keys. The case records the plan before the gate of #3328 exists.
why: Issue #3328: plans that add a field to `StageProposal` reach implementation without updating the prompt reply keys.
what_changes: Add the prompt keys gate to `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_eval_gates.py`.
Add the tests of the gate to `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_eval_gates.py`.
feasibility: `check_proposal` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` runs in the stage job and in the replay, so one rule judges both.
existing_tool: The change adds a deterministic gate to the stage job, which already checks plans offline, so no second check appears.

decisions.decision: Run the gate in the stage gate set
decisions.reason: The stage job and the replay both call it, so one code path gives one answer.

rejected.alternative: Check prompt only in prompt test
rejected.evidence: The prompt test runs after implementation, which is too late to catch a staging defect.

added.name: Prompt key gate
added.text: The stage job SHALL refuse a plan that adds a field to `StageProposal` without updating prompt reply keys.

scenarios.name: Missing prompt key
scenarios.when: A plan adds a field to `StageProposal` and no group changes the prompt file.

groups.title: Add the dependencies field to StageProposal
groups.test: Build a `StageProposal` and assert that `content_problems` returns no problem
